claim: Intrinsic pursuit is EVENT-DRIVEN, not polled: a state-changing event fires one coalesced selection cycle, which reads the frontier from `_intrinsic_pursuits` and routes each frontier kind to its real closer — knowledge to the understand loop, capability to a competence drive goal, environment to its own reaction. No timer, no stub routes.
hypothesis: If selection were polled or stubbed, a burst of events would produce more than one cycle and a seeded not-knowing would not reach the frontier the cycle actually reads.

metrics.name: frontier_pursuits_total
metrics.note: every pursuit the frontier holds, unlimited

metrics.name: frontier_distinct_scores
metrics.note: distinct score values — 1 would mean the ranking carries no information

metrics.name: frontier_score_spread
metrics.note: best minus worst across the whole frontier

metrics.name: seeded_rank
metrics.note: position of the freshly-seeded gap among 106 pursuits; present but > 50 means crowded out, not missing

metrics.name: seeded_present_unlimited
metrics.note: TRUE with a bare rank beyond the cut distinguishes a ranking fault from a wiring fault

checks.label: knowledge → a Research goal for the understand loop (no drive)
capability → a competence DRIVE goal (_execute_drive_goal reads drive/domain_id/scope)
environment → None (closed by _react_investigate_environment, not a queued task)
intrinsic values derive from the pursuit (novelty=entropy, curiosity=score)
one state-changing event → exactly one selection cycle
a BURST of 6 events collapses to a single-flight selection (≤2 cycles)
the seeded not-knowing surfaces as a frontier pursuit
the event drove the REAL selection cycle to run
no task queued only because a real gate declined (wiring still fired)

notes: DISCRIMINATION, not wiring: the seeded gap IS on the frontier at rank 91/106, below the limit=50 cut. Pursuits scoring identically tie at the cut, and which one surfaces is then decided by the structural tiebreak rather than by merit.
